incidents.title: Joined the stand-up an hour early
incidents.summary: The first Monday after the daylight-saving change, a calendar entry stored as a fixed offset fired an hour early. The meeting room was very quiet.

updates.message: Investigating why nobody else is in the call.
Resolved. Event re-created in the America/Edmonton time zone instead of a UTC offset.

incidents.title: Asked for JSON, received an essay
incidents.summary: A language model politely explained the JSON it was about to return instead of returning it. Mitigated with a schema, a validator and lowered expectations.

updates.message: Parser reports 'Sure! Here is your JSON:' is not valid JSON.
Resolved. Output now validated against a Pydantic model, with a retry on failure.

incidents.title: Pull request description longer than the diff
incidents.summary: A three-line fix shipped with a twelve-paragraph description. Reviewers were briefly unable to find the code.

updates.message: Reviewer requests a summary of the summary.
Resolved. Added a TL;DR at the top; the rest moved to the docs.
